definitions.full: H7766. Shunem שׁוּנֵם proper name, of a location in Issachar ; — Josh 19:18 (P), 1Sam 28:4 ; 2Kin 4:8 ; Σουναν[μ] , Σωμαν , Σουμαν , ᵐ5 L Joshua Συνημ ; in Egyptian Ša-n-m-â, Ša-na-ma WMM As.u.Eur.170 ; modern Sûlem , north of Zer`în ( Jezreel ), Buhl G 217 , compare GASm G 400 ff .
definitions.rootNote: probably from the same as 7764 ; quietly ;

occurrences.englishText: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.
One day Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.
